deadline.value: Advertised projects each set their own deadline, and you can also apply at any time with your own proposal.
deadline.quote: There are two main routes to undertaking a research project at Strathclyde - either by applying for an existing project or pursuing your own specific areas of interest. | You can apply at any time – all you have to do is pick your course and submit your application.

gre_subject.value: The chemistry page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: You can name a supervisor in your application, but an offer follows only once a second supervisor is confirmed.
supervisor.quote: As soon as a second supervisor is confirmed, an offer will be sent to you through Pegasus, our online application system.

funding.value: Funding depends on the project or scholarship, and only three fully funded studentships are open to international candidates.
funding.quote: Please note there are only 3 fully funded studentships available for international candidates.

entry_route.value: The stated entry is an honours degree; the University's general page says research applicants normally have a Masters, so check with the department.
entry_route.quote: For PhD or MPhil, you will need a first-class or upper second-class UK Honours degree, or overseas equivalent, from a recognised academic institution.

also.quote: If you wish to apply for a research degree you'd normally have to have a Masters degree and some experience of research work.

notes: Asks for a recent UKVI-recognised Secure English Language Test (SELT) if English is not the first language, rather than a band score.
